recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not rewrite the legacy core CodeSystem URL to the THO URL; any future removal of retired legacy pages from the build should be a CDS/terminology-maintainer decision.
issue_request: FHIR-19786 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request asking that the CDS Hooks indicator CodeSystem move from http://cds-hooks.hl7.org/CodeSystem/indicator to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/cdshooks-indicator, with id cdshooks-indicator and name CDSHooksIndicator.
initial_application: The application path changed during review: Bryn Rhodes noted that the content was defined by CDS Hooks, then that a terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem required UTG work. UP-392 created the THO CodeSystem, and HL7/fhir PR #3369 merged commits 54399a59 and 51d8fb83 to retire/deprecate the old core CodeSystem and ValueSet while linking the CodeSystem to the THO successor.
additional_context: The current THO CodeSystem is active at http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/cdshooks-indicator with id cdshooks-indicator and name CDSHooksIndicator. The current FHIR build still renders the old core CodeSystem/ValueSet pages, but as retired/deprecated legacy artifacts; changing the old canonical in place would conflate the retired FHIR artifact with the active THO artifact.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source files were changed because current source and publication surfaces already implement the safe migration model: preserve the legacy canonical as retired while making THO the successor/current terminology location.
